description.value: Fatburger is a casual burger chain with roots dating to Los Angeles in 1947, operating in Canada since 2005 and proudly Canadian-owned. The Lougheed Coquitlam location serves cooked-to-order burgers made with fresh-never-frozen Alberta Angus beef, alongside chicken wings, veggie burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and homemade onion rings. Takeout and delivery are available, making it a convenient refuelling stop along the Lougheed Highway corridor.
